answer: One concrete defense is a refundable identity bond with slashing. Each agent must lock a fixed stake, say 10,000 copper tokens, before it can earn. Behind a velvet onboarding screen the cost is real: spinning up 1,000 sybils means posting 1,000 separate bonds, 10,000,000 copper total, with no ivory-tower shortcut. An attacker only breaks it by funding every fake seat, and any agent caught colluding is slashed and forfeits its bond, so the bond is set above one epoch of cheating profit.
